name: mirofish
description: MiroFish - 简洁通用的群体智能引擎，预测万物

scripts.setup: npm install && cd frontend && npm install
scripts.setup:all: npm run setup && npm run setup:backend
scripts.backend: cd backend && uv run python run.py
scripts.graphscope:setup: cd graphscope/frontend && npm install && cd ../backend && uv sync
scripts.graphscope:backend: cd graphscope/backend && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8008
